eligibility.population: source-defined healthcare, health-and-social-care, or facility staff cohort

candidate_resolution.unit_of_analysis: one independent source-defined screening or diagnostic cohort
candidate_resolution.retain: parallel source-defined cohorts only when their recruitment arms are explicitly independent
candidate_resolution.prefer: whole source-defined cohort over an overlapping respondent subset
candidate_resolution.serial_measurements: retain the first study-defined timepoint and do not pool later measures from the same cohort
candidate_resolution.serial_programmes: retain the first source-defined period when overlap between later programme periods cannot be excluded

rules: Apply the declared eligibility requirements and exclusions in this profile.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
